messages:
Sophia: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to lock owners and due dates for the cache-eviction + degraded-kv incidents. I'll list proposed items.

Sophia: 1) TTL tuning + cache eviction safeguards -> owner? 2) Canary rollout for KV pool -> owner? 3) Long-term: add regression eval -> owner?

Jared: I'll own TTL tuning + safeguards (INF-8421). Will create ticket and add acceptance criteria by EOD.

Marta: I'll be accountable for the canary rollout. @Jared please coordinate on rollout testing with Eng-SRE.

Jared: Created ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8421 — summary: 'cache: TTL tuning + eviction safety net'. Acceptance criteria in description, assigned to Jared, due 2026-03-25.

Lia: I'll take the regression eval and prompt set vetting. Ticket INF-8422, draft PR for eval harness coming tomorrow.

Sophia: RACI matrix (quick): R=Jared (TTL), A=Marta (rollout), C=Eng-SRE (test), I=Platform/Support. Lia R for eval, A=Research.

eng-sre-bot: [incident-bot] Reminder: add runbook link to ticket and attach traces. See /incidents/2026-03-18-cache-eviction.

Marta: noted — I'll add runbook link and set up a 30m handoff with oncall next Tues 11am PT. @Jared @Lia pls confirm availability.

Jared: 11am PT works for me.

Lia: I can do 11am PT but prefer 11:30 if possible — ok to shift 30 mins?

Marta: 11:30 ok. I'll update the calendar invite and add meeting agenda: handoff, rollback plan, post-rollout validation.

Sophia: Timeline check: TTL tuning PR -> staging by 2026-03-22, rollout canary 2026-03-24, full rollout 2026-03-28. If anyone hits blockers call it out in this thread.

Jared: Will post PR link + test results here when ready.

Lia: Putting QA steps in INF-8422 now. Also flagging a recurring pattern: eviction spike tends to follow large training snapshot uploads — filing a separate tracking ticket to correlate uploads and eviction behavior.

Sophia: Good catch @Lia. Please add that tracking ticket and mark as 'monitored' in the ops dashboard.

Jared: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/4312 — includes metric for eviction rate and a safety throttle. Tests green on CI.

Marta: Dropping checklist: add runbook link, schedule handoff cal, confirm PR tests, create rollback command docs, close tickets when validation passes. I'll update INF-8421 checklist tonight.

Sophia: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after the handoff — next update here by 2026-03-23.

QA-Team: QA will validate canary for 48hrs and post pass/fail as comment on INF-8421.

Sophia: closing loop for now :thumbsup:
